## Company Information

## What 360Ghar Offers

- Property search for buy, rent, and PG. Listing availability varies by market.
- Some property listings may include a 360-degree tour. Check the listing.
- Selected locality pages with property search links. Details vary by place and may need independent verification.
- AI assistant workflows through the 360Ghar MCP server
- Real-estate tools. Check each tool for its scope and limits.

## Data Hub Tools

Available tools and data pages. Other source-dependent pages are held while source and update checks are reviewed:

- Haryana Jamabandi record lookup: https://360ghar.com/verify-ownership - looks up a record and does not independently verify legal title, possession or ownership
- EMI estimate: https://360ghar.com/emi-calculator - calculates a monthly payment from entered principal, rate and tenure; it does not compare lender rates or assess eligibility
- Area Converter: https://360ghar.com/area-converter - converts the factors shown in the tool; local land-unit definitions can vary, so check source documents
- Loan estimate: https://360ghar.com/loan-eligibility-calculator - an illustrative amount from entered values and a fixed 50% income-share assumption, not lender eligibility or approval
- Property sale gain worksheet: https://360ghar.com/capital-gains-tax-calculator - pre-tax arithmetic on sale price, purchase price and transfer expenses; it does not estimate income tax
- Property document prompts: https://360ghar.com/property-document-checklist - a non-exhaustive list of prompts; the tool does not review documents or confirm title or legal compliance
